retention.basis: P12 fixture qualification (artifacts/graph-engineering/p12-qualification.json): the largest accepted run left 2.09 MB under .orchestrator (control DB + WAL 2.07 MB, artifacts + attempt inboxes + journal 14 KB). 1 GiB covers 500 such runs even charging the whole database to each. Fixture transcripts are tiny; the real pilots may revise it.
retention.caveat: fixture runs write tiny transcripts; the real-pilot measurement (s3) may revise the default (_p12_open_threads)

experiments.name: route & graph policy
experiments.state: baseline graph (implementer, gate, proof_review, merge, accept); candidates and extra nodes off
experiments.evidence: fixture lanes only; no token or pass-rate measurement across the six classes

experiments.name: repository context value
experiments.state: Layer 1 (Python tree-sitter facts) on; Layer 2 (SCIP) not built
experiments.evidence: no measurement of search loops or context volume (D07 gates Layer 2)

experiments.name: validation cache & affected invalidation
experiments.state: engineering.affected_checks defaults to shadow; authoritative needs qualify_affected
experiments.evidence: promotion needs zero false cache hits over 50+ real commits; none recorded

experiments.name: plan repair vs fresh retry
experiments.state: plan repair on, bounded by engineering.max_plan_repairs (default 1)
experiments.evidence: the escalation ladder uses it; no token or fix-rate comparison with a fresh retry

experiments.name: scheduling heuristics
experiments.state: priority -> aging -> downstream leverage (P08, accepted launch-order policy)
experiments.evidence: no starvation or median-latency comparison against FIFO on a real backlog

context_gate_mapping.WorkUnit: run (task_runs: one compiled workflow revision of a task)
context_gate_mapping.Session: node (node_states) and the agent session on its attempt (attempts.session_id, session_mode)
context_gate_mapping.ContextSnapshot: attempt (attempts.manifest_artifact_id, the context manifest artifact on the claim)
context_gate_mapping.GateDecision: no maestro structure yet; the gate is not built (P12 §4). The routing decision on the attempt (binding_json) is where one would sit
context_gate_mapping.OutcomeRecord: attempt outcome (outcome_ref, failure_kind/class) with Usage (usage_start_json/usage_settle_json), plus acceptance_decisions
context_gate_mapping.seams: none found that force a second wrapper process or a gate bypass: every agent launch goes through WorkflowRunner.launch_worker
